messages:
Maya: tiny-hat-tree contest idea: make a 2.5" desk tree and top it with a hand-made tiny hat. prize: office brag + mystery snack box :tophat:
Jon: love it. can we also have a cookie-class category? best cookie wins a wooden spoon trophy :cookie:
Samir: i'll judge cookies remotely if needed. allergic to tree glitter though, pls keep it low-shed :grimacing:
Tess: remote folks can enter with a photo + 10 sec caption. i'll hand-deliver tiny hats for winners next week if you DM your address.
ops-bot: Reminder: no open flames in common areas. See holiday safety guidelines: https://intranet/redwood/safety-holiday :information_source:
Maya: good call. no candles or hot glue. craft glue and washi tape are fine.
Jon: quick logistics poll: react :one: if you want Friday 3pm, :two: Friday 5pm, :three: Saturday 11am.
Samir: :one: for me. also proposing a "most sustainable" subcategory for recycled-material trees.
Tess: Facilities, any chance of extra fairy lights and a box of tissue paper?
Facilities: Facilities: We can put a small bin of fairy LEDs and tissue by Reception Friday AM. Also found a roll of kraft paper for wrapping/structure.
Maya: heroic work, Facilities. i'll bring scissors and a tiny first aid kit for snips.
Jon: cookies: vegan option pls. who's baking?
Samir: i'll bring an eggless oat batch. labeling clearly for allergens.
Tess: remote kit idea posted here: https://drive.redwood/holiday-kits 50% will be recycled paper + a mini LED and a tiny hat template.
Maya: theme suggestion: "desktop winter wonder". keep political themes out, cozy only, pls.
Jon: judging: i'll pick best hat design, Samir picks cookie, Tess picks sustainability. winners announced Monday 9am.
Samir: also tiny hat category: funniest, most elegant, and most homemade. three prizes each.
Tess: posting sign-up sheet: https://forms.gle/example 5 add dietary notes for cookies.
Maya: final note: hashtag for photos: #tinyhat2026. post a before/after and one-line caption. remote entries paste photos here when ready.
Jon: preemptive kudos to Facilities and Ops for the kit supplies :clap:
ops-bot: Kudos recorded 5 Facilities tagged. +1 on the holiday-helpers leaderboard.
Facilities: pumped to see tiny hats and cookies. may the fluff-free glitter win :sparkles:
Maya: see you Friday 3pm (or wherever the votes land). may your glue hold and your hat stay perched! :star:
